notes.content:

notes.title: PATCH 1.3: NIKO UPDATED
notes.content:
[img] http://www.nikodream.com/presskit/Niko_Presskit_files/patch1.3.jpg [/img]


Dear dreamers!
Based on your feedback, we have finished a new update with the following changes:

[list]
    [*]Performance improvements for old computers
    [*]Difficulty adjustments in platforming
    [*]New checkpoints added
    [*]Control sensibility adjustments
    [*]Several graphical improvements
[/list] 


You can leave any comment on the forums, we appreciate your feedback and opinions.
Thank you for helping us making Niko a better game!

notes.title: PATCH 1.2: NIKO CONFIG APPLICATION
notes.content:
Dear dreamers.
You were asking for an improved way to personalize your Niko experience, so we have been working on that. Now you have the Niko Config Application to help you get a better experience.
If you have any comment, suggestion or whatever just use the fórums or contact us (we are always willing to help!!)


[img] http://www.nikodream.com/images/Config0_1.jpg [/img]


[h1] SETTINGS[/h1] 

VIDEO:
- RESOLUTION
- FULLSCREEN
- VSYNC
- FOV

GRAPHICS:
- MSAA
- ONEFRAME THREADLAG
- ANISOTROPIC FILTERING
- AMBIENT OCCLUSION

KEYS:
- KEYBOARD CONFIG
- PAD CONFIG
- MOUSE SMOOTHING
- INVERT MOUSE/PAD
- SPEED MOUSE/PAD

OTHER
- LANGUAGE
- CAMERA BOB


█ LOCATION APP :
It can be launched from the steam library through Config Game Option

notes.title: 10-minute making of included in the game.
notes.content:
We are pleased to present you a 10-minute making of the game, called THE ART OF NIKO. You can find artworks, the creative process of our heroine, along with drawings and all the promo material, as well as a very relaxing music. We hope you enjoy the documentary.

You can find it here: Steam\\\\SteamApps\\\\common\\\\NikoTTD\\\\BONUS

we’ll hope you enjoy!

notes.title: NIKO FINISHES ITS DEVELOPMENT!
notes.content:
So the day has come, friends, Niko: Through the Dream is finished!!
It has been a long way up to this point. We have laughed, cried and suffered…suffered again and again… and today we return to laugh. Thank you for being at our side in the beautiful journey of game making, we have felt you very close, you have helped us to improve and do our best. Thank you for all your support  sharing with you this adventure. In the name of the staff of this beautiful dream, we hope you enjoy this experience as much as we have enjoyed the making!!

THANK YOU VERY MUCH EVERYBODY!!


^___^

notes.title: Niko release date delayed.
notes.content:
Dear friends,

These days we've performed a lot of testing in order to deliver the best posible final product. We have detected an issue with some PC configurations, so we have decided to delay the game a little bit.

As soon as this issue is solved, a final release date will be announced.  

Studio Paint deeply apologizes for the inconvenience.
